mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in GDP growth rate signals a robust demand environment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during early-cycle expansions (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate below 3.5% triggers an increase in borrowing and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when FEDFUNDS is below 3.5% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the unemployment rate above 5% signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when UNRATE is above 5% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production signals an increase in supply, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when INDPRO is increasing (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in housing starts and retail sales signals a strong demand environment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when HOUST and RSAFS are both increasing (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate and an increase in the money supply signal an expansionary monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when FEDFUNDS is declining and CPIAUCSL is increasing (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate below 4% and an increase in payroll employment signal a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when UNRATE is below 4% and PAYEMS is increasing (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in GDP growth rate and retail sales signals a strong demand environment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when GDPC1 is above 2% and RSAFS is above 5% (t-test p > 0.05).
